about_short_description.short_description: Procurified helps simplify construction tendering for buyers and sellers.

product.name: Construction Tendering Platform
product.description: A platform that connects construction buyers and sellers to streamline the tendering process, including RFQ issuing, offer comparison, and budget tracking.

product.name: Vendor Portal
product.description: A self-service portal where vendors maintain their profiles and manage their participation in procurement activities.

product.name: Estimation Tool
product.description: A tool for construction professionals to create accurate and customizable cost estimates using historical data.

product.name: Procurement Tracker
product.description: A feature that enables users to monitor procurement progress, manage communication, and control costs throughout construction projects.
